Reverse a String Using Stack

Problem Statement
Given a string, reverse it using a stack.
Description
Read a string. Push each character of the string onto a stack from left to right, then pop all characters off the stack one at a time to build the reversed string.
Input Description
A single line containing a string s (1 ≤ length of s ≤ 100).
Output Description
Print the reversed string.
Sample Input
hello
Sample Output
olleh
